# dspc_role (Resource)

Manages a role in the authorization service.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `actions` (List of String) The list of permission actions assigned to this role (e.g. "vm:CreateVM", "uam:ListUsers").
- `name` (String) The name of the role. Must be unique within the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the role (equals the role name).
